direction: Capacity-tightness & clustered-geometry aware ruin scoring with stagnation-gated diversification: replace the plain |removal_savings| rank-power rule with a multiplicative gate chain sc = |sav|/scale * (0.5+load_util)^a * (1 + b*(d(0,i)/mean_depot_dist)) * (1 + c*route_dist_share), then apply rank-power p that grows from ~0.8 to ~2.5 as stagnation_ratio rises, and mix in a small fraction of relatedness-driven (Shaw-like) neighbourhood picks in the top-q so tight-capacity clustered instances escape depot-proximity bias rather than repeating near-identical ruins.

operations.mechanism: KB entry method-cvrp-m3-ruin-recreate-l3 confirms score_ruin_nodes as the sole evolvable hook with a controlled multiplicative gate + rank-power form, verified at 500 ms and documented as strong for stagnation-aware diversification; method-cvrp-lns-shaw-regret motivates relatedness-driven ruin for clustered geometries. Archive shows the only remaining headroom is a 0.17% portfolio band and that tight capacity / clustered / eccentric-depot regimes are weakest, so the next evolution step targets exactly those factors via load-utilization and depot-share gates plus stagnation-scaled rank power, keeping the deterministic Regret-2 repair and R2R acceptance untouched (no postprocess) to preserve the ~2-3 ms first-feasible and full 500 ms search horizon.

preserve: Route feasibility, strict time budget, and scale invariance.
hypothesis: The dev_24 residual error concentrates on tight-capacity, size-100, clustered instances with eccentric depots (per archive weakest_regimes). Hypothesis: gating ruin priority by route load utilization and depot-distance share, and raising the rank-power exponent with stagnation_ratio, will make the LNS ruin selection diversify into spatially coherent clusters at high stagnation while still removing cost-heavy nodes early, lowering mean objective below the 0.17% SBS/VBS band (i.e. beating 15.9328) without increasing per-instance solve time above the 500 ms budget.
